title: Watch: Calm couple, unfazed jogger defy chaos on streets of France
summary_full: France is currently facing significant protests driven by rising living costs and deteriorating public services. While some residents appear unfazed by the chaos, many cities have witnessed violent rioting and looting. The government has implemented tighter security measures after over 2,400 individuals were arrested during recent unrest. Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu has suggested localised curfews to curb further violence.
